title: dedicated-autoscaler: add burst_capacity and fleet utilization reporting (v6)
author: Sana Malik
description: Add burst capacity controls and expanded fleet utilization reporting for Dedicated fleets. Motivation: enable predictable short-term throughput spikes without overprovisioning sustained capacity, and provide operators visibility into burst usage and spillover events. Changes: 1) Autoscaler parameters: introduce 'burst_capacity' (tokens/sec polite limit), 'burst_window_s' (window size), and 'sustained_throughput_slo' with enforcement policy. 2) Runtime: per-fleet token accounting + soft/failover thresholds; automatic routing to reserve pools when sustained SLO is violated. 3) Telemetry: new metrics redwood.dedicated.fleet.burst_usage, .burst_spillovers, .sustained_utilization_percent and per-model breakdowns exported to Prometheus and the Console. 4) API/config: Dedicated fleet config proto + REST update endpoints. 5) Migrations: DB migration to add burst config table and backfilling job. 6) Console: new Fleet -> Utilization tab with time-series and alerts. 7) Tests and docs: unit/integration tests and updated docs. Backwards compatibility: default burst_capacity is null (no burst) so existing fleets unaffected. Rollout: feature-flag gated for gradual rollout. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked - [x] unit tests - [x] integration tests - [x] console dashboards - [x] DB migration with backfill - [x] QA signoff - [x] docs updated
